SUPABASE_URL.description: Keep the Supabase project used by TapInDex account sign-in. This is a public project URL, not a key.

SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.description: Paste the publishable client key for the existing Supabase account project. Never use a service-role or admin key.

BACKUP_KEYS_JSON.description: Paste the complete JSON generated locally by START_HERE.html. Keep a secure copy. Do not generate a replacement key for an existing service.

BACKUP_KEY_ID.description: For a new service use v1. This must match a key in BACKUP_KEYS_JSON.
